title: Fintech Mobile App Icon System
problem: The mobile banking app had inconsistent icons across different screens. Some icons were filled, some outline, and stroke weights were not aligned. This created confusion and poor visual hierarchy.
research: I studied modern fintech apps like Revolut and Stripe to understand minimal icon systems. The direction focused on simple geometric shapes, consistent stroke weight, and clear metaphors.
review: Amazing work! The icons improved our product experience significantly.
